question: How often does a roll land on a printed oddity?

series.label: % of rolls that land on the odd cell

finding: Comes up in play and needs a ruling: defender +2: no row for 34-36 (8.3 % of rolls in that column). Cannot occur, since the odd part is not a reading two dice can make: attacker -2: 20 % row reads 13-18. The Morale Modifier cell on this item is not measured yet.
